Na Pooch Mera Hussain Kya Hai?

1
Jahan-e-Azme Wafa Ka Paikar
Khrad ka Markaz, Junoon Ka Mahwar
Jamal-e-Zehra, Jamal-e-Haider
Zameer-e-Inssan, Naseer-e-Daawar
Zameen ka Dil, Asmaan Ka Yaavar
Dayar-e-Sabro Reza ka Dilbar
Kamal-e-Eessar ka Payambar
Shaoor-e-Aman –o-Sukoon ka Paykar
Jabeen-e-Insaaniyat Ka Jhoomar
Arab Ka Sehra, Ajam Ka Zewar
HUSSAIN TASWEER-E-AMBIYA HAI

2
Hussain dil hay, Hussain Jaan hay
Hussain Quraan ki zuban hay
Hussain Sajdon ki sar zameen hay
Hussain Zehnon ka aasmaan hay

3
Hussain Ahl-e-Wafa Ki Bastee

Faza Se warna Qaza Barastee
Urooj-e-Haft, Aasmaan-e- Azmat
Hussain ke Naqsh-e-Pa ki Masti
Hussain ko khuld me na Dhoondo
Hussain Mehnga, Hai Khuld Sastee
Hussain Maqsoom-e-Deen–o-Imaan
HUSSAIN MAFHOOM-E- "HAL ATA" HAI

4
HussainDil hai, Hussain Jaan Hai
HussainQuraan kee Zaban Hai
Hussain Irfaan Kee Saltanat Hai
Hussain Sarkaar –E-Do Jahan Hai
Hussain Sajdon Kee Sar Zameen Hai
Hussain Zahnon ka Asmaan Hai
Hussain Zakhmo Bharee Jabeen Hai
Hussain Azmat Ka Astaan Hai
Utha Raha Hai, Jo Lash-E-Akbar
Hussain Boodha Nahin Jawan Hai
Woh Sar-Kharoo-e- Nasheb-e-Sehra
Woh Sar Buland-e-Sar-Sana Hai
Woh Badr-e-Afllak-e-Admiyat
WOH SDAR-E-ARBAB-e KARBALA HAI

5
Hussain Eeman Ki Justajoo Hai
Hussain Yazdan kee Abroo Hai
Hussain Tanha Tha Karbala Me
Hussain Ka Zikr Chaar Soo Hai
Furaat Kee Nabz Ruk Gayee Hai
Hussain Masroof-e-Gufatagoo Hai
Jahan Gulabon Se Kat gaya Hai
Hussain Shayad Lahoo Lahoo Hai
Hayat Ke Irtaqa Se Pucho
Hussain Payghambar-e-Namoon Hai
Hussain Ka Hosla Na Poocho
Hussain Lut Kar bhee Surkharoo Hai
Woh Dekho Faujo Ke Darmayan Bhee
HUSSAIN TANHA DATA HUA HAI

6
Hussain Nikhra Hua Qalandar
Hussain Biphra Hua Samandar
Hussain Baste Dilon se Aage
Hussain Ujde dilon Ke Andar
Hussain Sultan-e-Deen-O-Imman
Hussain Afkaar ka Sikandar
Hussain Se Aadmee ka Rutba
Hussain Hai Aadmi Ka "Man-Dar"
Khuda Ke Bakhshish Hee Khema Zan Hai
Hussain Kee Saltanat ke Andar
Hussain Daata, Hussain Raja
Hussain Bhagwan, Hussain Sundar
Hussain Akaash ka Rishi Hai
HUSSAIN DHARTEE KEE AATMA HAI

7
Hussain Maidan Ka Sipahee
Hussain Dash-E-Ana ka Raahi
Hussain Farq-e-Ajal ka Bal Hai
Hussain Andaaz-e-Kajkalahi
Hussain Ki Garde-e-Pa Zamana

8
Hussain Fikr-o-Ana Ka Ghazee
Hussain JangGaah Me Namazee
Hussain Husn-e-Nayaz Mandee
Hussain Aijaz-e-Be-Nayazee
Hussain Aaghaz-e-jaan Nesaree

Hussain Saare Jahan Ka Waris
HUSSAIN KEHNE KO BE NAWA HAI

9
Hussain Payghambar-e-Baharaan
Hussain Taskeen-e-Dilfigaraan
Hussain Meer-e-Hejaz-e-Hastee
Hussain Saalar-e-Shehsawaran

Hussain Sar-Maya Ambiya Kaz

Hussain Ek Dil Nasheen Kahani
Hussain Dastoor-e-Haq ka Baani
Hussain Abbas Ka Sarapa
Hussain, Akbar Ki Naujawani
Hussain Kirdaar-e-Ahl-Imman
Hussain Meyaar-e- Zindagani

heading, roman = body.strip().split('\\n\\n', 1)
roman = roman.replace('HussainDil', 'Hussain Dil').replace('HussainQuraan', 'Hussain Quraan').replace('JangGaah', 'Janggaah')
roman_lines = []
for line in roman.splitlines():
    line = line.lower()
    if line:
        line = line[0].upper() + line[1:]
    line = re.sub(r'\\b(hussain|zehra|haider|arab|ajam|quraan|karbala|yazdan|furaat|akbar|khuda|hejaz|muharram|abbas|qasim|asghar|sajjad|baqar|dajla|zainab|kulssom)\\b', lambda m: m[0].capitalize(), line, flags=re.I)
    line = line.replace('\"hal ata\"', '\"Hal Ata\"').replace('\"man-dar\"', '\"Man-Dar\"')
    roman_lines.append('  ' + line if line else '')

source_blocks = source.split('\\n\\n')
assert len(original_blocks) == len(source_blocks) == 10
for roman_block, source_block in zip(original_blocks, source_blocks):
    number, *verses = roman_block.splitlines()
    urdu_number, *urdu_verses = source_block.splitlines()
    assert number.translate(str.maketrans('0123456789', '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹')) == urdu_number
    assert len(verses) == len(urdu_verses)
meta = meta.replace('language:', 'alternateTitle: \"' + heading + '\"\\nlanguage:', 1)
meta = meta.replace('direction: \"ltr\"', 'direction: \"rtl\"').replace('tags: [\"noUrdu\"]', 'tags: []')
p.write_text('---' + meta + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + '\\n'.join(roman_lines) + '\\n---\\n\\n' + source + '\\n')
print(sum(len(block.splitlines()) - 1 for block in source_blocks), 'verses across', len(source_blocks), 'stanzas')

Reconstructed 125 Urdu verses across all 10 stanzas in the selected lyric and verified that the verse counts match stanza by stanza. Preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, added the Roman alternate title, set the direction to RTL, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous Roman forms “Li Lughad” and “Jabr-o-Azoor” as `کی لغت` and `جبر و جور`. The Roman block retains both readings as transcribed.
